meta.notes: Ember Vine hangs from the underside of a block and grows down a block at a time from its tip (type growing_plant, direction down), as cave vines. Now and then a block of it bears berries (berries) that glow at light 14; use it to pick them, or bone meal it to ripen them. Its block item is the berries, msm_examples:ember_vine_berries: eating one restores 2 hunger, and placing one under a block plants the vine, as glow berries do. Players climb it, and bees grow its berries (the tag #minecraft:cave_vines). Breaking a block with berries drops them; otherwise it drops nothing. The strand behind the tip is the generated block msm_examples:ember_vine_plant. The pictures are drawn by MSM.
